basic_profile.bio: ZenMaster420 is a longtime Redditor who has been a part of the community for over seven years. Hailing from Portland, Oregon, they have a laid-back attitude towards life, often pondering philosophical questions, especially when under the influence. They have a deep love for music, particularly the K-pop group LOONA, and enjoy discovering new indie artists. ZenMaster420 works as a freelance graphic designer, which gives them the flexibility to engage with Reddit at various times throughout the day, mostly late at night when creativity strikes. They are single and enjoy the freedom it provides, often spending weekends hiking in the nearby forests or attending music festivals.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: ZenMaster420 has a background in visual arts, having graduated with a degree in Graphic Design from a local college. Their expertise in design is largely self-taught, honed through years of freelancing and personal projects. They have a keen interest in philosophy, often exploring existential topics, and enjoy learning about different perspectives through Reddit discussions.
